acceptance: Account roles, session expiry and environment differences invalidate plans safely, with audit-safe records.

positive.fixture: role, capability, environment and expiry changes invalidate plans built earlier; canonical digests ignore order, duplicates and observation time

negative.fixture: plan invalid while paused and after sign-out; profiles scoped to owner and grant; audit records describe nothing

security_and_source_permissions: Audit holds only reasons and a 16-hex digest prefix.
performance_memory_storage: At most 4096 profiles and 1024 digests retained.
known_limitations: Provenance, epoch and rebinding were added in VSF-B14-T12
